kind: scale-safe area-weighted surface normals: paired correctness/cost diagnostic
methodology: Identical offline release probe source and lock in isolated baseline/candidate timing/allocation targets. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice (four fresh processes/version), one warmup and five samples/case. Checked CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID; no task-owned builds/checks/tests during timing. Cold standalone prepare_chunks includes validation, surface traversal, position/scalar gathering and normal computation; source construction excluded, output validation/hash/drop outside clock. Twenty-six cases: canonical and discontinuous-cell 16/48 cubed grids at scales 1, 1e-12, 1e12, 1e-30, 1e30; general 16/48 controls; 256/65536 disjoint ordinary and degenerate triangles. Every geometry hash/payload must match cross-version; ten scale=1 ordinary normal hashes must match. Extreme-scale normals intentionally differ, with candidate nondegenerate unit-normal checks and independent public normal/shading fixtures as oracle. Separate allocation processes count calls and positive realloc growth, not live/peak memory. F64 retry adds eight temporary bytes/position component, reuses existing normal output, and releases the workspace before cell splits. It is not an aggregate host memory budget. Separate allocator-disabled time -l fresh-process 65536-triangle preparations at scales 1/1e-12, ABBA twice per scale, include source construction/validation and output hashing. RSS is process maximum, not physical GPU/mobile memory. Thermal/affinity uncontrolled. No whole-app, GPU execution or measured-energy claim. Shared area weighting is checked within chunks; cross-chunk continuity and original f64 position/scalar precision remain open. Final range classification is deferred and zero-face checks are moved after accumulation; reference normals use original source f64 edges. Initial and intermediate per-face/quantized-edge diagnostics are retained separately.
